zh: 任务看板：优化平板详情抽屉的打开、关闭和高度变化动画，减少侧栏打开时的工作量。
优化手机和平板的详情抽屉、滚动条和按钮布局，修复 Android 导航栏遮挡及停止按钮文字显示问题。
卡片新增计划进度胶囊，点击可展开清单；可在设置中控制显示并预览。
详情长标题超过五行后自动折叠，统一卡片和详情中的操作按钮。
在隐藏任务弹窗中可直接清除筛选，恢复看板列表。
搜索时显示已加载的会话数量。
修复恢复历史会话时，任务被错误归入「运行中」的问题。
已完成或取消的 provider 子任务保留 7 天，方便回看。
搜索界面不再分别显示未覆盖和读取失败的数量，也不再提供失败会话重试；任务标题、项目等元数据仍可搜索。
聊天体验：宿主通知作为时间线消息显示。
隐藏 oh-my-pi 工具调用产生的占位回复。
拒绝将网络路径和设备路径当作本地文件读取。
en: Tasks Board: Improved animations for opening, closing, and resizing the task details sheet on tablets, and reduced the work needed to open the sidebar.
Improved the details sheet, scrollbars, and button layouts on phones and tablets. Fixed Android navigation bar overlap and stop button label display.
Added a plan progress capsule to task cards. Tap it to expand the checklist; control its visibility and preview it in settings.
Long detail titles now fold after five lines, and action controls are more consistent across cards and details.
Clear filters directly from the hidden tasks dialog to restore the board list.
Search now shows the number of loaded conversations.
Fixed restored conversations being incorrectly placed in the Running lane.
Completed and canceled provider subagents remain visible for seven days.
The search UI no longer reports unavailable and failed conversations separately or offers retries for failed conversations. Task metadata, such as titles and projects, remains searchable.
Chat Experience: Host notices now appear as timeline messages.
Hidden placeholder replies generated by oh-my-pi tool calls.
Network and device paths are no longer treated as local files.
